audience.value: NASA Space Apps Challenge judges and attendees: technically literate, short on time, not necessarily InSAR or landslide specialists.

communication_intent.value: Explain the problem and how the platform works first; then persuade the judges that PRECURSOR AI is a credible, reusable use of NASA radar data for the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge.

audience_outcome.value: Judges can say in one sentence what PRECURSOR AI does, which NASA datasets it uses and why it matters, and they scan the QR code to try the app.

core_message.value: Open NASA data in, one usable landslide early-warning map out: PRECURSOR AI sees landslides before they happen, from space.

delivery_context.value: Primary: presenter-led live pitch of a few minutes on a projected screen. Secondary: the deck is shared with judges as part of the submission and read without a presenter.

artifact_afterlife.value: Submission artifact for the challenge; reused as the base deck once the Lorem ipsum placeholders are replaced with real results.

content_divergence.value: Follow the supplied 9-slide plan: same slide order and titles, plan wording kept, Lorem ipsum placeholders kept as written. Steps 1-4 and Dashboard text on the How-it-works slide reuse the previous deck.
